blocks.text: Jerusalem—A flydubai plane heading to Tel Aviv from Dubai was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, after one of the pilots allegedly tried to crash the plane and kill everyone onboard. Flight FZ 1073 took off from Dubai at 0305 GMT. READ: Israel-bound plane diverted after pilots reportedly injured in fight Here’s what we know about what unfolded on board: 0521 GMT. Sudden loss of altitude The aircraft suddenly plummeted a little over two hours into the flight. The plane dropped from nearly 34,000 feet at 0521 GMT to less than 17,000 feet at 0522 GMT, […]...
